t: A free browser editor for Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with optional school classes.
steps: Open the Raspberry Pi Code Editor in a web browser.
Write a short Python program and run it.
Try an HTML page with a little CSS.
Follow the Foundation setup journey to create a school account.
Create a class and add students.
Remember that Login with Google was not available at launch.
Share a starter project and read the student feedback tools.
